action.label: Translate
dialog.title: Translate this entry
dialog.introBody: Translations are run sequentially. Each selected target locale will be overwritten. Markdown, HTML and rich-text structure are preserved.
dialog.cancelling: Cancellation requested — waiting for in-flight chunks to abort…
dialog.doneBody: Reloading the editor in the new locale…
dialog.previewToggle: Preview before saving (review diff before overwriting)
dialog.estimateCostSuffix: across {count, plural, one {# locale} other {# locales}}
dialog.overwriteWarning: {count, plural, one {# locale already has} other {# locales already have}} content and will be overwritten: {names}
preview.title: Preview translation to {locale}
preview.intro: Review the {count, plural, one {# proposed change} other {# proposed changes}} below. Nothing is saved until you click Apply.
preview.warningsTitle: {count, plural, one {# stale reference skipped} other {# stale references skipped}}
preview.acceptSelected: Apply {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
preview.selectHint: Uncheck a change to keep the current value for that field.
preview.keepingCurrent: This field will keep its current value.
summary.allDone: Translated to {count, plural, one {# locale} other {# locales}}
dialog.overwriteUnknown: Could not check whether the target locale(s) already have content; they may be overwritten.
summary.allDoneBody: Pick a locale below to open its translated entry.
summary.warningsIntro: {count} reference(s) across the translated entries point at records that no longer exist. They were left empty — please review and re-link them manually.
summary.partialBody: Some locales failed — see the list below for details.
summary.failedBody: None of the target locales were translated.
toast.multiPartial: Translated {done} of {total} locales — review the rest.
toast.pickLocale: Please pick at least one target locale.
settings.title: Translate
settings.header.title: Translate
settings.header.subtitle: Tonality and terminology used when translating entries with the LLM.
settings.voice.title: Voice and tone
settings.voice.description: Free-form instructions injected into the translator's system prompt. Describe the desired voice, register, or product-specific phrasing.
settings.voice.label: Instructions
settings.voice.placeholder: e.g. Warm, inviting hospitality copy. Keep tone natural to the target language — do not translate literally.
settings.voice.hint: Plain text. Avoid contradicting the built-in rules (HTML preservation, JSON output, etc).
settings.preserve.title: Preserve exactly
settings.preserve.description: Terms kept verbatim across all target locales — brand names, place names, product names.
settings.glossary.title: Per-locale glossary
settings.glossary.description: When translating to the selected locale, the LLM is told to prefer the target term over a literal translation. Example: "Motorhome Pitches" → "Private Campsites" for English.
settings.glossary.empty: No mappings yet for this locale.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
settings.diagnostics.description: Translation memory cache and provider credit usage. Refresh to read the live state.
settings.diagnostics.cacheDisabled: Cache is disabled in plugin config (cache.enabled: false).
settings.toast.glossaryImported: Glossary loaded into the form. Click Save to persist.
bulk.title: Bulk translate
bulk.header.title: Bulk translate
bulk.header.subtitle: Translate every document of one content type into one or many target locales.
bulk.scope.title: Scope
bulk.contentType.hint: {count} translatable field(s) walked on each document.
bulk.docs.title: Documents
bulk.docs.empty: No documents found for this content type in the chosen source locale.
bulk.docs.truncated: Showing the first {cap} documents — refine the source locale or split the run to translate the rest.
bulk.run.title: Progress
bulk.toast.pickLocales: Pick at least one target locale.
jobs.title: Translation history
jobs.header.title: Translation history
jobs.header.subtitle: Recent translation jobs. Auto-refreshes while jobs are in flight.
jobs.empty: No jobs in memory. Start translating from any entry and the run will appear here.
changes.intro: Pick the modules to send for translation. Everything else in the translated versions stays as it is.
changes.linkedHelp: Links to items that already exist in the target language are kept automatically. Turn this on to also translate pending changes in linked items and create missing ones.
changes.initialHelpMissing: {languages} {count, plural, one {doesn't} other {don't}} have this entry yet. Turn this on to create {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} with a translation of the whole entry, including anything not selected above. You review it before anything is saved.
changes.initialHelp: Languages without this entry get a full translation instead of only the changed modules.
changes.generatingHelp: Nothing is saved until you review and apply the changes.
changes.initialIntro: {language} doesn't have this entry yet. Applying creates it with the full translation below.
changes.reviewIntro: {selected} of {total} changes selected. Uncheck a change to keep the current translation.
changes.missingLinks: {count, plural, one {# linked item isn't} other {# linked items aren't}} available in {language}
changes.missingRequired: A required link can't be left empty. Go back and turn on “Also translate linked items” to create the missing translation.
changes.missingOptional: Go back and turn on “Also translate linked items” to create the missing translation, or apply without these links.
changes.draftHelp: Changes are saved to the draft. Publishing stays a separate step; content types without drafts are updated live.
changes.appliedHelp: The approved changes are saved. If this content uses drafts, visitors see them only after you publish {language}.
changes.alignHelp: The {language} version has several modules that could correspond to the changed ones. Pick the matching module, then generate the preview again.
changes.moreFields: + {count, plural, one {# more field} other {# more fields}}
changes.matchMissing: Pick the {language} module that translates this one.
changes.matchNone: Every {language} module of this type is already matched to another one. Go back and leave this module out, or add it to the {language} version first.
changes.matchNoneChosen: Nothing is removed from the {language} version.
changes.matchClash: Also picked for {module}. Each {language} module can only be matched once.
changes.matchRemoved: This {language} module is removed when you apply the translation.
changes.matchHelp: This page has several modules of the same type, and the plugin can't tell yet which {language} module translates which {source} module. Check the pairs below so the changes land in the right place.
changes.matchHelpSuggested: Each pair is pre-selected by position and content. Compare the texts and change any pair that doesn't fit. After you apply the translation, the plugin remembers these pairs.
changes.title: Translate saved changes
changes.pending: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} not translated everywhere yet
changes.none: No pending changes. Save an edit to translate just the modules you changed.
changes.needsInitial: Turn on “Create missing languages” to translate into {languages}.
changes.childMissingLinks: {label} links to {count, plural, one {# item that isn't} other {# items that aren't}} available in {language}
changes.childMissingRequired: A required link can't be left empty. Translate the linked item first, then generate the preview again.
changes.childMissingOptional: Apply without these links, or translate the linked item first and generate the preview again.
changes.introNew: This entry only exists in {language} so far. Pick the languages to create it in. You review every translation before anything is saved.
changes.allUpToDate: All languages are up to date.
changes.introMissing: Every existing language is up to date. Pick the missing languages to create this entry in. You review every translation before anything is saved.
